// diagnostic

E0126

Default expression references a later parameter (D-NARG-D2)

What

Default expression references a later parameter (D-NARG-D2)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0126

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0126: tests/ui/default_forward_ref.stderr.

Error [E0126]: default for `a` in `f` references `b`, which comes after it
  --> tests/ui/default_forward_ref.jet:1:13
    |
  1 | fn f(a: Int{b}, b: Int) Int -> a
    |             ^
 Why: defaults fill left to right; a parameter isn't in scope until it appears in the list
 Fix: reorder the parameters so `b` comes before `a`, or use a constant default
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0126

Error [E0104]: `f` expects 2 arguments, got 1
  --> tests/ui/default_forward_ref.jet:3:10
    |
  3 |     _ :: f(1)
    |          ^
 Why: every argument must match a parameter
 Fix: check the definition of `f`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0104
